activity.notes: Tenure as Roman prefect of Judaea, conventionally dated c. 26–36 CE. The role is tied to Roman imperial administration rather than a separate sovereign polity.

sources.title: Josephus, Antiquities of the Jews 18; Tacitus, Annals 15.44; Pilate Stone
sources.citation_text: Independent literary and epigraphic evidence for Pontius Pilate as Roman prefect of Judaea.
